title: Web Application Crawler: Discover All Endpoints, Forms, and Parameters Before Injection Tests
goal: AegisPT currently runs httpx (passive fingerprinting) and then immediately jumps to injection tests (xss-extended, nuclei, ZAP). But without first crawling the application, the runners don't know WHERE to inject — they only test the root URL. For Gruyere this means they never find /newsnippet, /saveprofile, /upload, /feed.gtl, or the profile color input. A web crawler must run as Phase 1's first step (after httpx), spider all reachable URLs within scope, extract: all HTML forms with their action URLs and input field names, all AJAX endpoints (from JavaScript analysis), all URL path patterns, all query parameters observed in links. This data is stored in the inventory snapshot as 'discovered_web_surface' so Phase 2 runners (xss-extended, auth-flow, idor-bac, ssti-probe, session-security) can use it as targets. The crawler uses the existing Playwright runner or httpx follow-redirects mode — it does NOT need a separate tool installation.
generation_reason: XSS-extended and other runners receive no candidate_paths or form contexts from prior runs because no crawler exists. They test only the base URL and find nothing. Gruyere's /newsnippet and /saveprofile are never discovered.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_enforcement: Only crawl URLs within the approved scope allowlist. Never follow external links. Check web_target_value_is_allowed_with_path() before requesting any URL.
constraints.passive_only: The crawler only follows GET links and reads HTML/JS. It does NOT submit forms or click buttons. Form submission is reserved for auth-flow and active runners in Phase 2.
constraints.depth_limit: Max crawl depth: 5 levels. Max URLs: 500 per target. Respect rate limit from run safety settings.
constraints.no_new_tool: Use httpx or Playwright (already installed). Do not require new external tools.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep implementation bounded to this task package. Defer broader scanner, exploit-chain, UI, or runtime work to separately queued packages.

implementation_notes.output_format: Store discovered surface in inventory_snapshot as: discovered_forms=[{action_url, method, inputs:[{name, type, value}]}], discovered_endpoints=[url], discovered_parameters={url: [param_names]}, discovered_ajax_endpoints=[url].
implementation_notes.integration: The output feeds into xss_extended (candidate_paths + upload_contexts), auth-flow (form URLs), idor-bac (parameter names), ssti-probe (template input fields).
implementation_notes.profile_name: Register as 'passive-web-crawler' in run_profiles.py. Add to FULL-EXTERNAL-WEB Phase 1 profiles after passive-web-baseline.
implementation_notes.implementation: Use httpx with HTML parsing (beautifulsoup4 or html.parser) to follow links. Extract <form>, <input>, <a href>, fetch() calls from inline <script>.
implementation_notes.gruyere_specific: For path-component testing: also record URL patterns like /{id}/{action} where {action} varies — this enables path-based XSS testing.

acceptance_criteria: Running passive-web-crawler against Gruyere discovers at minimum: /newsnippet, /saveprofile, /upload, /feed.gtl, /home, /snippets.
Discovered forms include the snippet form (POST /newsnippet, field: snippet) and profile form (POST /saveprofile, field: color).
xss-extended runner can read candidate_paths from inventory and test them.

success_criteria: Running passive-web-crawler against Gruyere discovers at minimum: /newsnippet, /saveprofile, /upload, /feed.gtl, /home, /snippets.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
after_completion: Promote the next true open task into NEXT_TASK.md, or record that no active backlog task remains.

out_of_scope: Running live public target scans without explicit operator authorization and approved scope.
Bypassing approval gates, scope/ROE boundaries, runtime binding, credential protections, or kill-switch behavior.
Materializing credentials or sensitive data outside protected references.
